Home/Private sessions

Private sessions

A little more time.
A pace of your own.

An individual session concept for people who want more space to ask questions and explore the basics.

Ask about a session
01

Begin with a conversation.

Tell the studio what brings you in: getting familiar with movement, building confidence before a group class, or understanding the equipment. An individual session should have a clear purpose shaped around you.

02

Make the plan personal.

A real instructor would discuss relevant experience, preferences, and suitability before proposing a session. Ask about the format, duration, equipment, pricing, and cancellation policy so you know what to expect.

  • Your starting experience and comfort level
  • What you would like to understand or practice
  • Any suitability questions to discuss with an appropriate professional
03

Find your next step.

Private and group formats can serve different needs. The aim of this example is to make the options easy to understand and the inquiry comfortable to send. It does not claim rehabilitation services or clinical outcomes.
